title: Haze4K local-action target measurement qualification
rationale: The frozen Haze4K development oracle established large GT-privileged spatial headroom, while the closed proxy family failed to realize it out of scene. This orthogonal supplement does not change the model, action set, representation, classifier, or protected-data policy. It measures whether continuous local-action utility learned from three nested haze variants transfers to the held-out fourth variant across four fixed grid origins, while preserving location specificity, non-clipping direction, SSIM, and color safety. The target regret scene variance is unavailable before this run, so pre-run precision is recorded honestly as descriptive capacity; every terminal returns to stage 1 and never directly authorizes stage 2.

orthogonal_changes.reason: This route replaces proxy-family tuning with a direct cross-variant and measurement-perturbation qualification of the frozen continuous GT utility target.

scientific_contract.question: On the isolated 100-scene Haze4K development partition, is the fixed three-action GT utility stable enough that an action field selected from three haze variants has less than 0.10 dB worst-grid PSNR regret on the held-out fourth variant, with adequate achieved precision, material scene coverage, location specificity, non-clipping direction, and SSIM/color safety?

intervention.primary_variable: leave-one-haze-variant-out transferred local action field versus the held-out variant GT per-tile oracle
intervention.reference: held-out-variant GT-selected per-tile best action from the identical weaken 0.8, keep 1.0, and strengthen 1.2 set
intervention.matched_budget: one frozen official ConvIR-B inference per each of 400 nested variants followed by deterministic replay of the same three actions over four fixed 32-pixel grid origins; zero training or fitting
fixed_factors: only the isolated 100-scene development_screening asset is delivered; candidate confirmation and NH-HAZE remain absent
official ConvIR-B base graph with 8,630,665 frozen parameters and strict checkpoint load
action formula clip(hazy + scale times (official_prediction minus hazy), 0, 1)
action set weaken 0.8, keep 1.0, and strengthen 1.2 with exact ties resolved to keep by fixed action order
per-tile action selection maximizes mean continuous per-pixel RGB-MSE improvement over the other three registered haze variants
each of four haze variants is held out once and scored only after its source action field is fixed
grid origins are exactly (0,0), (0,16), (16,0), and (16,16) pixels with valid boundary pixels weighted by area
primary scene regret is the maximum across grids after averaging the four held-out variant regrets
material scene coverage uses the minimum across grids of transferred-minus-GT-best-uniform PSNR averaged over variants
negative control circularly shifts the dense transferred action field by 32 pixels on both axes while preserving its pixel action frequencies
non-clipping sensitivity selects source actions only from pixels common to all three unclipped candidate outputs and uses keep for an empty tile support
RGB MSE defines action utility and PSNR defines primary outcome; whole-image RGB SSIM and absolute channel-bias define safety
20,000 complete-scene bootstrap resamples use fixed seeds 20260729, 20260730, and 20260731
four variants, tiles, pixels, grids, and metrics remain nested repeats and never increase independent n

primary_estimand.metric: mean canonical-scene maximum-grid held-out GT-oracle-minus-transferred PSNR regret, qualified only when its one-sided 95 percent scene-bootstrap upper bound is below 0.10 dB and the upper-bound distance from the point estimate is at most 0.05 dB
primary_estimand.aggregation: for each grid average four held-out variant regrets, take the maximum grid regret within canonical scene, then equal-weight complete-scene bootstrap across all 100 scenes

controls: keep scale 1.0 must reproduce the official prediction and have exactly zero duplicate utility
non-clipped pixels must obey the exact residual-scale manipulation
every shifted grid must cover each valid pixel exactly once
held-out GT per-tile oracle must not have higher RGB MSE than the transferred action field
a 32-pixel circularly shifted dense action map preserves action frequencies but breaks local position alignment
common non-clipped support checks whether action direction survives removal of clipping-induced rank changes
whole-image SSIM and color evaluation prevents invalid additive tile interpretation
strict scene-level aggregation prevents variants, tiles, pixels, or grids from becoming independent samples

uncertainty.method: 20,000-resample complete-scene bootstrap for continuous means and two-sided 95 percent Wilson intervals for material-benefit and harm prevalences; achieved regret upper-bound distance is reported explicitly

gates.estimand: exact oracle and proxy terminal identities, isolated 100-scene role, 400 finite inferences, complete four-grid measurement, no protected asset, and no training
one-sided 95 percent complete-scene bootstrap upper bound for worst-grid leave-one-variant-out PSNR regret in dB
distance from primary point estimate to its one-sided 95 percent upper bound in dB
Wilson lower bound for scenes whose minimum-grid transferred-minus-GT-best-uniform PSNR is at least 0.10 dB
one-sided 95 percent complete-scene bootstrap lower bound for worst-grid aligned-minus-circularly-shifted PSNR in dB
one-sided 95 percent complete-scene bootstrap lower bound for worst-grid common-nonclipped-source-minus-GT-best-uniform PSNR in dB
upper 95 percent Wilson bound for scenes whose worst-grid mean transferred-minus-uniform RGB SSIM is at most -0.005
upper 95 percent Wilson bound for scenes whose worst-grid transferred-minus-uniform absolute RGB channel-bias is at least 1/255

scientific_contract.competing_explanation: A large original GT oracle gain may be unstable across nested haze versions, depend on hard 32-pixel boundaries or clipping, optimize RGB reconstruction rather than perceptual quality, or rely on privileged target access that does not identify deployment-visible information. Conversely, a stable target would still not show that any representation or predictor can recover it out of scene.
disabled_actions: delivering or accessing the 150-scene candidate-confirmation asset or NH-HAZE
training, proxy fitting, module construction, representation selection, classifier selection, or threshold adaptation
changing the official model, checkpoint, action scales, grid origins, metric definitions, margins, controls, or terminal mappings after launch
claiming stable GT utility identifies deployment-time predictability, representation insufficiency, a physical haze mechanism, or perceptual optimality
treating haze variants, tiles, pixels, grids, or metric repeats as independent statistical units
automatically entering stage 2; every terminal must first rerun the stage-1 design qualification

precision_contract.rationale: The primary regret scene SD is unavailable before this supplement. A conservative 1.05 dB planning SD from the related parent oracle interval makes the frozen 0.05 dB half-width infeasible at n=100; achieved precision is therefore a preregistered inconclusive-only gate and every outcome returns to stage 1.

capability.production_path_statement: The exact official Haze4K ConvIR-B graph is strict-loaded and frozen, then the exact leave-one-variant continuous-utility selection, four shifted grids, GT-oracle regret, circular-shift negative control, non-clipped support sensitivity, whole-image PSNR/SSIM/color metrics, complete-scene bootstrap, Wilson intervals, and terminal finalizer execute on a device-aware no-data fixture.

precision.estimand: mean canonical-scene worst-grid leave-one-variant-out PSNR regret
precision.source_reference: Conservative planning SD 1.05 dB was derived before this run from the frozen parent bounded-oracle scene-bootstrap interval; the much narrower closed-proxy interval was not used to claim feasibility for the new regret estimand.
